name: Aditya Shah
player_statement:
A complete player, Aditya Shah has made a big mark in cricket. With 12 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 17, with an average of 8.78 and a quick strike rate of 91.86. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 3.4 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 4.64. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
